abort.already_configured: This FloLogic account is already configured.
abort.no_valves: This FloLogic account has no controllable valves.

init.title: FloLogic options
init.description: Choose how often Home Assistant refreshes FloLogic data. Keep session alive reuses one cloud websocket, listens for pushed valve updates, and reconnects automatically if FloLogic closes it. Monitored valves controls which valves this install tracks; changing it reloads the integration. Previously selected valves remain selectable if temporarily missing. Reopen this form to refresh the valve list.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach FloLogic, so the valve list could not be refreshed. Other options can still be changed.
error.no_valve_selected: Select at least one valve to monitor.
error.unknown_valve_selected: The valve selection is no longer valid. Reopen the options and try again.

select_valves.title: Select valves for {name}
select_valves.description: No previously registered FloLogic valves could be identified for {name}. Open the integration options and select the valves installed at this site. No valves will be monitored or controlled until you choose a selection.
